note: The curated tier. Hand-written, and empty is honest.

items.title: Olive Bar & Kitchen
items.why: A whitewashed Mediterranean restaurant in a courtyard facing the Qutub Minar. Book for dinner and ask for a table under the trees.
items.source: olivebarandkitchen.com; published coverage
items.coordsFrom: approximate (One Style Mile, Kalka Das Marg)

items.title: Qla
items.why: A terrace restaurant with a view of the Qutub Minar. Come at sunset for a drink, then stay for dinner.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Cafe Dori
items.why: An Italian café in the Dhan Mill compound. Order the fresh pasta and a pizza for a long lunch between the design stores.
items.source: LBB; Zomato

items.title: Potbelly
items.why: A rooftop in Shahpur Jat cooking Bihari food, rare in Delhi. Order litti chokha and the mutton curry, and sit on the roof.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Kampai
items.why: A Japanese restaurant in Aerocity's Worldmark with hand-painted walls, cherry blossoms and a tatami room. Order ramen and sushi.
items.source: EazyDiner; We Are Gurgaon

items.title: Comorin
items.area: Two Horizon Centre, Golf Course Road
items.why: A modern Indian restaurant and bar on Golf Course Road for inventive small plates and cocktails.
items.source: published coverage

items.title: House of Celeste
items.why: A 32nd Avenue restaurant known for Indian food with careful service and cocktails. Book for dinner in the courtyard.
items.source: We Are Gurgaon; published coverage

items.title: Khan Market
items.why: Delhi's smartest small market, two rows of shops with cafés upstairs. Start at Bahrisons and Full Circle for books, walk the boutiques, then climb to a café for lunch.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Janpath and the Tibetan Market
items.why: A long pavement of stalls selling silver jewellery, scarves, embroidered bags and handicrafts, with the Tibetan Market's covered row at its heart. Look at a few stalls before you buy, and bargain with a smile.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Sarojini Nagar Market
items.why: Delhi's bargain market, full of export-surplus clothes at street prices. Go on a weekday morning before the crowds, check seams carefully, and start at half the asking price.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Chandni Chowk bazaars
items.area: Kinari Bazaar, Dariba Kalan and Katra Neel, Chandni Chowk
items.why: The old city's wedding bazaars: Kinari Bazaar for trims and tinsel, Dariba Kalan for silver, and the katras off the main street for fabric by the metre. Take the metro, go in the morning, and stop for parathas between lanes.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism
items.coordsFrom: approximate (Kinari Bazaar, Dariba Kalan and Katra Neel, Chandni Chowk)

items.title: Dilli Haat, INA
items.why: An open-air crafts market where artisans from every state sell handlooms, pottery and metalwork in rotating stalls, with a food court of regional kitchens. Shop in the afternoon, then eat momos from the Northeast stalls.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: GK I M-Block and N-Block markets
items.why: Two neighbouring South Delhi markets of fashion labels and Indian-wear stores, with cafés and bars upstairs. Shop in the afternoon, then stay on for dinner.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: GK II M-Block Market
items.why: A smaller, calmer market ringed with restaurants and cafés. Come in the evening for a walk round the block and dinner.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Shahpur Jat designer lanes
items.why: An urban village whose narrow lanes are full of independent designers' studios for bridal and occasion wear. Wander slowly, look up at the upper floors, and stop for coffee or ramen between shops.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Meherchand Market
items.why: A quiet row of concept stores, homeware, and small labels by the Lodhi Colony murals. Pair it with the Lodhi Art District walk and a coffee.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: South Extension I and II
items.why: Long-established fashion and occasion-wear stores on both sides of Ring Road, from saree houses to big labels. Go with a list; it is where Delhi buys for weddings.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Kamla Nagar Market
items.why: The student market beside Delhi University's North Campus: cheap clothes, shoes and accessories, with momos, chole bhature and cafés in the lanes. Busiest in the late afternoon.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Karol Bagh and Ajmal Khan Road
items.why: A loud, packed shopping street for clothing, wedding outfits and jewellery, with Gaffar Market's electronics nearby. Go on a weekday afternoon; it closes on Mondays.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Galleria Market
items.why: Gurugram's neighbourhood market, a ring of everyday shops, bakeries and cafés around a courtyard. Come for coffee and an easy errand run.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: Sector 18 and Atta Market
items.why: Noida's central shopping district, where Atta Market's budget stalls sit beside the showrooms of Sector 18 and near the big malls. Good for everyday finds and dinner after.
items.source: published coverage; Delhi Tourism

items.title: INJA
items.why: Fine dining that joins Indian and Japanese cooking in a quiet boutique hotel. Take the tasting menu and book ahead.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Bukhara
items.why: The famous tandoor restaurant at ITC Maurya, where you eat with your hands at low wooden tables. Order the dal Bukhara, sikandari raan and a giant naan for the table.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Dum Pukht
items.why: Awadhi cooking at ITC Maurya, slow-cooked in sealed pots. Order the dum pukht biryani and the galouti kebab.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Baoshuan
items.area: The Oberoi, Dr. Zakir Hussain Marg
items.why: Upscale Chinese dining at The Oberoi. Come for dim sum and Peking duck on a special night.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage
items.coordsFrom: approximate (The Oberoi, Dr. Zakir Hussain Marg)

items.title: Kaméi
items.why: A contemporary Asian restaurant in Eldeco Centre, good for sushi, small plates and cocktails. Book for dinner.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Burma Burma
items.why: The Noida branch of the vegetarian Burmese restaurant in DLF Mall of India. Order the tea-leaf salad, the khow suey and a bubble tea.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Lair
items.why: A small, dim cocktail bar in Basant Lok with pan-Asian food. Sit at the bar and book on weekends.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Serai at Olive
items.why: The cocktail bar and terrace attached to Olive in Mehrauli. Come for a drink at sunset before dinner.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Cyber Hub SOCIAL
items.why: The big, casual Cyber Hub bar for after-work drinks and group hangouts. Easy, loud and cheap by Gurugram standards.
items.source: Zomato; published coverage

items.title: Gypsy Café
items.why: A café in the Hauz Khas Village lanes. Stop for a coffee between the ruins and the boutiques.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md)

items.title: Drums of Heaven
items.why: A Kolkata-style Chinese restaurant in Green Park. Order chilli chicken, Hakka noodles and the Kolkata mixed fried rice.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Evergreen Sweet House
items.why: A Green Park institution since 1963 for chole bhature, chaat and sweets. Go at lunch and finish with a sweet.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Rose Café
items.why: A pastel, flower-filled café, now at Eldeco Centre's arc of restaurants, loved for brunch and cakes. Order a slice of the cake of the day.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Arts Room
items.why: A café-restaurant at Eldeco Centre, with the building's lawns and fountains in front. Take a table outside on a mild day.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: 6 Ballygunge Place
items.why: The Delhi branch of the Kolkata Bengali restaurant at Eldeco Centre. Order the kosha mangsho, a fish curry and the buffet at lunch.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: HIKKI
items.why: A Nikkei restaurant at Eldeco Centre, mixing Japanese technique with Peruvian ingredients. Order the ceviche and tiradito.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Indy by Qla
items.why: A more casual Eldeco Centre restaurant from the team behind Qla in Mehrauli. Good for a relaxed dinner.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Mission Bay
items.why: The Mission Bay, an Eldeco Centre restaurant and bar with Californian-style food and cocktails.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: BeeYoung Brewgarden
items.why: A brewery garden from the Bee Young beer brand. Order a pint of the house beers outside.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md)

items.title: Tanjore Veg Dosa Café
items.why: A Malviya Nagar South Indian café for crisp dosas and filter coffee. Quick and cheap at lunch.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Bo-Tai
items.why: A Thai restaurant and bar in Mehrauli with a view of the Qutub Minar. Go for drinks on the terrace.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md)

items.title: ROOH
items.why: A modern Indian restaurant in Mehrauli, reworking regional dishes with Asian touches. Take the tasting menu.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Swan
items.why: A Mehrauli restaurant with Italian and Japanese food and a terrace near the Qutub. Go at sunset.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Zylo by Kakapo
items.why: A Mediterranean and sushi restaurant in Mehrauli from the Kakapo team. Good for a celebration dinner.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Dramz
items.why: A Mehrauli bar with a roof that looks at the Qutub lit up at night. Go after dark for a whisky.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Aban by Thai High
items.why: A Thai restaurant on a Mehrauli rooftop. Book a table outside for dinner under the Qutub.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Caara
items.why: The café inside the Ogaan store at Dhan Mill, calm and pretty. Come for lunch between design stores.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: The Bombay Club
items.why: A Dhan Mill restaurant in the old grain houses, cooking Bombay: dabeli, keema pav, brun maska with Parsi chai, and coastal stews with appam.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: The Palette
items.why: A Dhan Mill café where you can paint or play games while you wait for food.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md)

items.title: Chisme
items.why: A relaxed café on 100 Feet Road near Dhan Mill where nobody rushes you out. Good for a long coffee or a work session.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Mrs Kaur's
items.why: A Chhatarpur bakery-café known for sugar-free and gluten-free cakes, plus burgers and coffee. Order a slice of cake.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Celebrity's Table
items.why: A Chhatarpur restaurant for North Indian and Hyderabadi food. Order the biryani.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Shooters Café
items.why: A Chhatarpur café for coffee, pizza and pasta, opposite Tivoli Garden. Handy for a casual bite.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Third Roast
items.why: A Dhan Mill shop for fudge in many flavours and packaged coffee. Buy a box of fudge to take home.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Melt House
items.why: A second-floor GK II café for sandwiches, pasta and desserts. A good, calm lunch in the market.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Paris Coffeehouse
items.why: A French-style café in GK II's M-Block from pastry chef Sahil Mehta. Order a croissant and a café crème.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Agama
items.why: A fully vegetarian, farm-to-table café in GK II, opened in 2024, for pizza, salads and coffee. Come for a plant-based lunch.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: EDNA
items.why: A GK II lounge on two floors: a dark bar downstairs with a glowing halo-lit counter, and an open rooftop above. Start on the roof.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Nik Baker's
items.why: A GK II bakery run by an Australian-trained baker, serving breakfast all day. Buy a loaf and a slice of cake, or sit for eggs.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Urban Bethak
items.why: A cosy café in Champa Gali, the lane of cafés and workshops in Saidulajab near Saket metro. A slow afternoon stop.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Forest Bistro
items.why: A calm, green café in Champa Gali. Good for an unhurried lunch.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Green View Café
items.why: A Champa Gali café filled with plants. Sit in for coffee after walking the lane.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Dream Catchers Café
items.why: A rooftop café in Champa Gali. Go up at sunset.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Nerdy Indian
items.why: A Saidulajab café for book lovers, which lends you a book with larger orders. Settle in with a coffee and a read.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Pa Pa Ya
items.why: A pan-Asian restaurant known for bold, playful dishes, sushi and dim sum. Book for dinner.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Sattvik
items.why: A fully vegetarian restaurant with Jain and vegan options. Order the thali.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Harajuku Tokyo Café
items.why: A pink-and-neon Japanese café in Select Citywalk with a live baking counter. Order soufflé pancakes.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Solchemi
items.why: A calm Shahpur Jat café with specialty coffee, plug points, and a reading and painting corner. Order cloud eggs and stay to work.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Alayna Café
items.why: A small first-floor coffee stop in Shahpur Jat. Good for a quick break from the shops.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: USCO
items.why: A two-floor Shahpur Jat coffee bar. Take the quiet upstairs for a short work session.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Poochki Table
items.why: A rustic Shahpur Jat café attached to a fashion label. Order the pizza verde.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Spaced Out Café
items.why: A Shahpur Jat café popular with freelancers and designers. Good for working in a group.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Café 43
items.why: A cheap first-floor café on Shahpur Jat's fashion street for fries, pizza and wraps. Good for a quick bite while shopping.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: The Turkey Project
items.why: A plant-filled Defence Colony café for a coffee date. Order the fried chicken they call 'Fricken', or the lamb burger with a sangria.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Colonel's Kababz
items.why: The Defence Colony parent branch of a Mughlai chain, cooking kebabs, rolls and biryani for around 25 years. Order the seekh and a mutton roll.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Afghan Darbar
items.why: An Afghan restaurant in Lajpat Nagar 2, in the quarter where Delhi's Afghan community lives. Order the Kabuli Uzbek pulao, a chopan kebab, and sheer yakh ice cream.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Orange Room by Habbit
items.why: A Basant Lok café open from eight in the morning, for coffee, smoothies, seafood, pasta and burgers. Good for breakfast.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Kebab House by Habbit
items.why: The kebab kitchen of the Habbit group in Basant Lok. Order a mixed platter.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Cha Bar
items.why: The tea café inside the Oxford Bookstore on CP's outer circle. Buy a book, then sit with a pot of tea.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md)

items.title: The Blue Door Café
items.why: A small Khan Market café that does breakfast best. Order the avocado toast or the berry pancakes, and come before noon.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Pour Over
items.why: A Khan Market coffee roaster brewing Chikmagalur beans. Order a pour-over, or the spiced latte in winter.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Common Time
items.why: A wood-panelled Khan Market coffee shop that plays records, with good bakes and a small balcony over the trees. Take the balcony if it is free.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Andrea's Bar & Brasserie
items.why: Andrea's Bar & Brasserie in the middle of Khan Market, known for cocktails and a relaxed room. Go for an early evening drink.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Sly Granny
items.why: A Khan Market restaurant-bar in a whimsical vintage room, with a rooftop. Go for cocktails and continental plates.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Green Mantis
items.why: A pan-Asian restaurant in Khan Market for sushi rolls and bao. Order the tiger roll and the mushroom bao.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: The Chatter House
items.why: A small, affordable Khan Market bar with a rooftop. Good for cheap drinks before dinner.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: KLAP
items.why: A Khan Market bar known for inventive cocktails. Sit at the bar and ask what is new on the list.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Tranzit
items.why: A Khan Market all-day restaurant with global small plates given an Indian twist. Order a few to share, a signature cocktail, and the triple-chocolate dessert.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Daisy Mae
items.why: A Khan Market cantina for Chinese comfort food. Order the clay-pot chicken and the Shanghai spring rolls.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Town Hall
items.why: A Khan Market restaurant with a rooftop, serving Asian food and good sushi. Book a rooftop table on a cool evening.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Café Dali
items.why: A tiny Meherchand Market Italian café with an open kitchen and a handful of seats. Order the fresh pasta at a slow lunch.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Café Athyeka
items.why: A Meherchand Market café cooking Chettinad and Andhra food in a market of brunch places. Order the Chettinad chicken or a podi dosa.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Chor Bizarre
items.why: A Kashmiri and North Indian restaurant at Bikaner House, famous for a vintage car used as a salad bar in its first home. Order the Kashmiri wazwan dishes.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md)

items.title: Roasted by Roseate
items.why: Roseate House's patisserie café, overlooking lawns and a water channel in Aerocity. Order a pastry and a pot of TWG tea.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Café Pluck
items.why: The Pullman's all-day deli-restaurant for European, Italian and Indian dishes and fresh coffee. Good for a proper breakfast before a flight.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Pret A Manger
items.why: The British sandwich shop's Aerocity branch in Worldmark 1. Good for a quick breakfast before a flight.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Magnolia Bakery
items.why: The New York bakery, known for its banana pudding. Order the classic banana pudding.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: The Hazelnut Factory
items.why: A premium café in Worldmark 2 for specialty coffee and hazelnut desserts. Order anything with hazelnut.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Rêve
items.why: A cosy French bistro in Aerocity's Worldmark 1. Order coq au vin or crêpes.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Monsoon by Café Lota
items.why: An Aerocity restaurant from the Café Lota team, cooking regional Indian food with local produce. Order a regional dish and end with the kheer.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Qavalli
items.why: An upscale Middle Eastern restaurant in Aerocity for mezze and grills. Book for a special dinner.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Kheer
items.why: Roseate House's North Indian restaurant, cooking tandoori and curries in an open kitchen. Book for dinner.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Underdoggs
items.why: A sports bar with big screens, burgers and beer. Go when there is a match on.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: AnnaMaya
items.why: The Andaz hotel's food hall, built on Indian produce, with a bakery, ice cream and dishes from small producers. Good for a relaxed lunch.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: HonK
items.why: The Pullman's pan-Asian restaurant, with an open kitchen for dim sum, sushi and wok dishes. Book for dinner.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Himalayan Java
items.why: A Nepal-born coffee house in Majnu ka Tilla with views over the colony. Order a coffee and a Tibetan snack.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Wongdhen Café
items.why: A Majnu ka Tilla café with its own bakery, live music every day, and indoor, outdoor and terrace seats. Take the terrace.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Abongchiiz
items.why: A three-floor student café on Hudson Lane with a popular rooftop. Order the caramel coffee and the momo platter.
items.source: Delhi–NCR area directory (delhi/delhi.md); Zomato; LBB; EazyDiner; published coverage

items.title: Housefull Café
items.why: A Hudson Lane café with a rooftop for North Indian and Chinese food. Order the crispy mushroom and stuffed tandoori aloo.

items.title: Mama's Buoi
